title: Herringbone and chevron parquet floor
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of wood parquet in herringbone, double or triple herringbone and chevron, with exact periodic layouts, grain along each plank, bevelled joints, lacquer or oil finish and wear. Use for floors of rooms, halls and furniture panels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python herringbone_parquet.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 herringbone (square block ends against the next block's side), 1 chevron (ends cut at 45 degrees so the blocks meet in a straight centre line).

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.meaning: Block length in block widths; chevron uses the nearest even number.

parameters.name: planks
parameters.meaning: Planks laid side by side in each block: 1 single, 2 double, 3 triple herringbone or chevron.

parameters.name: repeats
parameters.meaning: Times the pattern repeats across the tile; more repeats make smaller blocks.

parameters.name: joint_width
parameters.meaning: Gap between planks in plank widths.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Width of the bevelled plank edge (a V groove between planks) in plank widths.

parameters.name: grain_contrast
parameters.meaning: Strength of the ring lines and pore streaks.

parameters.name: figure
parameters.meaning: Waviness of the grain lines along each plank.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Dull, lighter patches where the finish has worn.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Natural oak blocks in classic herringbone with a satin lacquer.

presets.name: double_walnut
presets.description: Dark walnut in double herringbone: pairs of narrow planks per block.

presets.name: chevron_ash
presets.description: Pale ash chevron with long boards meeting in a straight centre line.

presets.name: smoked_rustic
presets.description: Smoked, oiled oak herringbone with wide bevels, strong grain and wear.

limits: The zigzag always runs along the tile height at 45 degrees; other angles need a rotated UV. Grain is a geometric ring model (wavy lines bent into arches, finer rings and pore streaks), not wood anatomy: there are no knots, ray fleck or end grain. Blocks are flat with a slight tilt; there is no cupping, gapping by season or borders. At small output sizes the joints are thinner than a pixel and fade into the albedo. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Herringbone partition by (x - floor(y)) mod 2r in an axis-aligned frame
45 degree frame rotation chosen so both lattice periods land on the square tile
Chevron columns of parallelograms with alternating slope
Per-plank hashing for tone, grain frequency, runout and arch
Smooth one-dimensional value noise for grain waviness and pores
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
